title: Verified phone number as biometric precondition
details: Add a phone column, SMS verification flow, and accept 1 verified email + 1 verified phone as an alternative biometric precondition. Requires an SMS provider (e.g. Twilio, Vonage) as a new dependency with running costs.
resolution: Deferred by owner decision Q5 (2026-10-16): no SMS cost for now. Recovery email or 2FA serve as the second factor instead.

title: Let a channel creator lift a kick
details: A kick is permanent: the member can never rejoin by link, code, public entry or direct invite. A creator who kicks by mistake has no way to undo it. Add an 'Allow back' action for the creator (and the Phase 7 Admin III view) that changes the row from kicked to declined, so the member can be invited again.
resolution: Approved by the owner (Q12, 2026-10-16) and built in Phase 5 as part of MOD-TODO-01: Removed members list with Allow back on the channel page (creator only). The Phase 7 Admin III view should reuse rooms.kick.lift.
